noun_definition: Task refers to an action that can be assigned within the Workspace Chat, which requires a title and is expected to have consistent button behavior when navigating between pages.

Button behavior refers to the expected functionality of the Submit and Confirm buttons, which should consistently either be disabled after certain actions or display correct error messages when navigating between pages via URLs.
Submit refers to the action of finalizing and sending an expense entry in the application, which is expected to enable or disable the corresponding button based on the user's navigation and input.
Assign task refers to a feature in the application that allows users to create and manage tasks within the Workspace Chat interface.
url refers to the web address copied during the process of submitting expenses and assigning tasks, which is used to navigate between different tabs in the application.
